meta.name: Oil / Gas State-Conditioned OCF V5.8g
meta.objective: Rerun the frozen V5.8d state-conditioned OCF hypothesis with PIT source-gate repaired licensed futures state inputs.

universe.name: A-share oil/gas upstream, integrated, refining, natural-gas processing and distribution candidates
universe.construction: V5.8a PIT universe with V5.8d state-conditioned factor panel. HY01102 oilfield services remain excluded.

data.vendor: JoinQuant/DataJQ PIT financial fields + Tushare licensed futures state metrics injected through V5.8g source gate
data.external_state_policy: core source gate repaired with licensed futures data for crude, bitumen, LPG and refining-spread proxy; promotion sources still missing
data.business_exposure_policy: PIT JoinQuant industry membership proxy only; annual-report segment review is still required

price_adjustment.low_vol_panel: raw daily close history strictly before trade_date

data.source_warning: V5.8g is a research validation candidate with core source gate repaired. It still cannot be promoted without inventory/demand, tariff/policy, reviewed business exposure and cash dividend event repair.

factors.name: state_conditioned_ocf_score
factors.source: V5.8g PIT source-gate state buckets + operating_cash_flow_yield
factors.definition: OCF yield is active only when PIT cycle policy supports OCF interpretation.

factors.name: cycle_defensive_low_vol_score
factors.source: V5.8g PIT source-gate state buckets + low_vol_score
factors.definition: Low-volatility score is active when commodity state makes raw OCF less reliable.

factors.name: cycle_low_pe_diagnostic_score
factors.definition: Low PE diagnostic under refining-spread state; not a primary factor because cyclical earnings may be distorted.

factors.name: operating_cash_flow_yield
factors.definition: Raw operating cash flow divided by market capitalization.

factors.name: low_vol_score
factors.source: daily close returns strictly before trade_date
factors.definition: Composite of negative realized volatility, downside volatility and max drawdown.

factors.name: low_price_to_book
factors.definition: Lower PB is a diagnostic valuation reference.

factors.name: dividend_yield
factors.definition: Visible dividend yield, diagnostic until cash dividend events are repaired.

scoring.value_trap_guard: No hard guard is approved. State-conditioned OCF and defensive low-vol are a research hypothesis only.

schedule.rebalance_rule: first tradable day of quarter after PIT visibility check

portfolio.cash_policy: hold residual cash when fewer than eight names pass filters

defensive_rule.reason: V5.8d tests state-conditioned factor activation, not market timing.

individual_stop_loss_take_profit.reason: Fixed exits are not part of the research hypothesis.

validation.acceptance_rule: V5.8g may decide whether source-repaired state-conditioned OCF deserves Engineering preparation. It cannot become accepted from 2021-2026 evidence.
